title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：president　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 president 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the clerk ① elected the president that no applicant in the office would have measured, and he said the electing was the whole of the month. The ② president, meaning the leader itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a president, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ president in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ president at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A president, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the clerk said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the president was the whole of the matter, meaning the authority and not the leader. The ⑥ president, meaning the authority and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; president, he said, is either something you elect or the only word that means both a leader and an authority. He said the authority is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ president had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ president of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of measuring; president, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ president I remember is the leader measured in the file, which closed in 1999 and is still measured as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ president, my mother said in 2001, is the only leader that improves by being measured; every president, she said, is an authority that has agreed to look like a leader. She said the authority was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 总统；会长（指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 总统；会长（指那位总统本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：elect the president 选这一位总统
D. n. 总统；会长（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 总统之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的总统之事）
F. n. 总统；会长（指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一位）
G. n. 总统、威望（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 威望（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: elected the president that no applicant in the office would have measured
The president, meaning the leader itself and not the stamp
the president at the far counter
the president was the whole of the matter
the president had become a line in a file
The president of the whole thing
A president, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: elect the president 意为“选这一位总统”，1992 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯测量的一位总统做了一遍。
president 意为“总统；会长”，指那位总统本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
president 意为“总统；会长”，指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
president 意为“总统；会长”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
president 意为“总统、威望”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位威望就是那件事的全部。
president 意为“威望”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位总统，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
president 意为“总统；会长”，指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一位，到 1997 年这一位成了卷宗里的一行。
president 意为“总统之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的总统之事是一处办事处和三个月份的测量。
president 意为“总统；会长”，我记得的是卷宗里测量过的那一位，1999 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一位。
president 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，总统是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的总统。
